title: Repeated Varna municipal-transit conductors actions following November onset
status: December sources report physical repeat actions on December 2 and 3; event size and state-policy target remain unresolved. November 23 onset is linked in BNT’s December 2 account.
notes: The figure >270 refers to employees with layoff notices, not protest participants. Do not make a separate December event owner from the repeated same-demand actions unless review resolves a distinct episode; end date after December 3 is unknown.
